full_text_en:
Zhuo Xiaohong v. Sun Dexi and Chongqing Dairy Products Company — dispute over infringement of portrait rights

Plaintiff: Zhuo Xiaohong, female, 24 years old, employee of Chongqing Jiulong Garment Company, Sichuan Province.

Defendant: Sun Dexi, male, 42 years old, employee of the Advertising Product Photography Department of Chongqing Photography Company, Sichuan Province.

Defendant: Chongqing Dairy Products Company.

On November 25, 1986, the Shizhong District People's Court of Chongqing, Sichuan Province, accepted the case of plaintiff Zhuo Xiaohong v. defendants Sun Dexi and Chongqing Dairy Products Company concerning a dispute over infringement of portrait rights. The following facts were found upon trial:

In April 1983, when plaintiff Zhuo Xiaohong went to the Advertising Photography Department of Chongqing Photography Company to have a personal photograph taken, defendant Sun Dexi asked Zhuo to have another photograph taken for use as a sample image. Zhuo agreed but stipulated that the sample image could only be displayed on the counter inside the shop. In May 1985, employee Yang of defendant Chongqing Dairy Products Company, after being assigned the task of redesigning the bottle label for "Duowei Malt Milk," noticed a color photograph of Zhuo Xiaohong in profile being displayed on the counter of the Advertising Photography Department of Chongqing Photography Company. On June 9 of that same year, Yang directly negotiated with Sun Dexi, and Chongqing Dairy Products Company paid Sun RMB 40 to purchase that sample image of Zhuo. Yang modified the original sample image of Zhuo Xiaohong (adding one hand and one glass cup) to create a bottle label design, and then had Sun make a reversal film of it. Chongqing Dairy Products Company submitted the reversal film to a printing plant, which produced 492,000 printed bottle labels for "Duowei Malt Milk," and the products bearing the aforesaid label were gradually placed on the market. In July 1986, Zhuo Xiaohong discovered that her sample image had been used as a trademark and immediately raised objections to Sun Dexi and Chongqing Dairy Products Company, demanding cessation of the infringement, restoration of reputation, elimination of adverse effects, an apology, and compensation for economic losses. As the parties failed to reach an agreement, Zhuo Xiaohong filed a lawsuit with the Shizhong District People's Court of Chongqing.

The Shizhong District People's Court held in its trial: Article 100 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "Citizens enjoy the right to portrait; the use of a citizen's portrait for profit-making purposes without the consent of the person concerned shall be prohibited." Sun Dexi and Chongqing Dairy Products Company, without the consent of Zhuo Xiaohong herself and for profit-making purposes, unauthorizedly sold and printed another person's portrait for use as a trademark. Such conduct constitutes an infringement of the right to portrait. Pursuant to Article 120 of the General Principles of the Civil Law, which provides that where a citizen's right to portrait is infringed upon, the victim has the right to demand cessation of the infringement, restoration of reputation, elimination of adverse effects, an apology, and may also demand compensation for losses, Sun Dexi and Chongqing Dairy Products Company shall jointly bear the civil liability for the infringement. In light of the facts and the law, both defendants admitted the truth of the infringement and apologized to Zhuo Xiaohong in person. The Shizhong District People's Court conducted mediation. Through mediation, the parties reached the following agreement on January 8, 1987:

1. Chongqing Dairy Products Company shall immediately cease using the bottle labels for "Duowei Malt Milk" that use Zhuo Xiaohong's portrait as the original image, and shall destroy all 400,362 bottle labels that have not yet been placed on the market;

2. Sun Dexi shall compensate Zhuo Xiaohong for economic losses in the amount of RMB 150, and Chongqing Dairy Products Company shall compensate Zhuo Xiaohong for economic losses in the amount of RMB 300.

The case acceptance fee of RMB 30 shall be borne by Chongqing Dairy Products Company in the amount of RMB 20 and by Sun Dexi in the amount of RMB 10.
